pages.title: Monster Chef
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Monster Chef puts you in a busy restaurant serving robot customers. Work with moving ingredients and cooking machines while keeping up with hungry guests. Tap to play and handle the kitchen's food-preparation tasks as the monster chef tries to keep the restaurant running.

pages.title: Car Eats Car 3D
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Car Eats Car 3D mixes racing with combat against alien invaders. Complete missions, battle bosses, and use attacks such as biting, shooting, and smashing to destroy enemy vehicles. Unlock cars, improve their stats, and equip weapons. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, drop bombs with Space, and activate turbo with Left Shift or M.

pages.title: My Perfect Farm
pages.creator: Tapfire
pages.description: My Perfect Farm starts with a small piece of land to develop into a larger farming business. Plant seeds, harvest crops, and feed animals while managing the farm's resources. Upgrade buildings and open additional areas as the farm grows. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse, and left-click to interact with crops and improvements.

pages.title: Potion Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Potion Sort asks you to separate layered liquids until every bottle holds a single color. Tap one bottle to select it, then another to pour its top layer. The receiving bottle must be empty or have the same color at the top. Keep spare bottle space available as you plan the sequence needed to sort each level.

pages.title: Cake Merge
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Cake Merge turns cake slices into a tray-management puzzle. Place plates so identical slices sit next to each other and merge automatically. Completed cakes disappear to free space, allowing you to continue earning points and discovering desserts. Linked plates share a placement, making it necessary to leave space for the entire group.

pages.title: Merge Smith
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Merge Smith is a blacksmith-themed merging game. Combine two identical weapons to create a stronger one, then keep building toward higher-level equipment. Accumulating more powerful weapons increases the money you can earn as you work toward making legendary items.

pages.title: Fitness Club 3D
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Fitness Club 3D puts you in charge of developing a fitness studio. Help clients with their workouts, watch their exercise form, and take part in aerobics activities to earn money. Work toward expanding the studio into a larger fitness business, using mouse clicks or touch input to play.

pages.title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Live Star Doll Dress Up lets you personalize an anime-style doll with clothing and makeup. Choose fashionable outfits and experiment with cosmetics to give the character a look of your own. Use mouse clicks or taps to work through the makeover options.

pages.title: Hamstercycle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hamstercycle follows a hamster escaping a professor's laboratory on a homemade ride. Jump across furniture and scattered objects, working toward each room's exit portal. The floor is protected by laser sensors, so landing there means getting caught. Click, tap, or press Space to jump through the physics-based courses.

pages.title: Metro Escape
pages.creator: isotronic
pages.description: Metro Escape is an escape-room puzzle set in a metro. Search for useful objects, examine patterns in the surroundings, and use the collected items to solve riddles that help you find a way out. Left-click to interact with objects as you investigate the area.

pages.title: Cat From Hell Cat Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Cat From Hell Cat Simulator turns you into a troublesome cat inside Granny's house. Knock over objects, break plates and fish tanks, and throw balls to cause a mess. Explore the rooms for more things to destroy and get away before Granny catches you. Click or tap to play through the cat's challenges.

pages.title: Robbotto
pages.creator: JMJ Interactive
pages.description: Robbotto is a retro-style arcade platformer set aboard a ship. Travel through its areas and defeat the enemies along the way, playing alone or with a friend. Use the keyboard or mouse to play, with arrow keys for menu navigation and Enter to make a selection.

pages.title: MineBlocks 3D Maze
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: MineBlocks 3D Maze is a block-pushing puzzle in a three-dimensional world. Move the player with WASD or the arrow keys and push the blocks onto the altars placed around each level. Work out where the blocks need to go and guide them into their required positions.

pages.title: Archery Ragdoll
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Archery Ragdoll is an archery game built around ragdoll physics. Hold the mouse or a finger behind the archer's back to draw the bow, keep holding while you aim, and release to shoot. Touch control uses the highlighted area on the left side of the screen.

pages.title: Jailbreak Assault
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Jailbreak Assault follows a prisoner fighting through a guarded escape route. Take a dropped key, open the cell, and use a baton against guards before reaching stronger weapons. Missions include destroying documents, disabling cameras, and opening new areas on the way to the outer perimeter. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press E to interact, and left-click to use a weapon.

pages.title: Monster Truck Crush
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Monster Truck Crush is a race against an AI truck with balance affecting your speed. Reach the finish first by controlling the vehicle's body angle and settling it correctly on each new platform. A balanced landing lets you accelerate immediately; an awkward one can slow the truck or make it roll. Click or tap to play.

pages.title: Crystal Connect
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Crystal Connect follows two dwarves collecting gems through tile-linking puzzles. Clear the field by pairing matching crystals, choosing connections whose paths have no more than two bends. Work through the levels and their obstacles, looking for the next available pair as the layout becomes more complicated.

pages.title: Turn The Screw
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Turn The Screw is a mechanical puzzle built from iron plates, nuts, and bolts. Work out how to loosen the fastenings and free the metal pieces from the assembly. The challenge centers on the arrangement of the pinned plates and the screws holding them in place.

pages.title: Merge Fighting 3d
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Merge Fighting 3d combines weapon merging with battles against groups of enemies. Join matching equipment to obtain stronger weapons, then use them to defeat the opponents surrounding you. Swipe to play and continue through the levels as the fights call for more powerful gear.

pages.title: Ship Clicker
pages.creator: GamesdMurdock
pages.description: Ship Clicker lets you earn money by operating and improving a ship. Press and hold while fuel is available to increase your earnings. Spend the money on upgrades for the ship and crew, or save toward buying another vessel. Improving the ship raises the income it can generate.

pages.title: Duel Of Builders
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Duel Of Builders is a weapon duel against the computer or a friend. Move around the arena, change weapons, and attack the opponent. Player one uses WASD to move, R to change weapons, and Space to attack; player two uses the arrow keys, O, and P for the same actions.

pages.title: Penguin Dash
pages.creator: grimmtec
pages.description: Penguin Dash sends a penguin across an automatically generated path of boxes. Move left or right to avoid obstacles and keep progressing before the boxes behind you disappear. Tap either side of the screen or use the left and right arrow keys. Quick route choices help keep the penguin from falling and extend the distance record.

pages.title: Maze Mania
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Maze Mania is a timed labyrinth puzzle with eight mazes to solve. Find a route from the entrance to the exit before the clock runs out, working through the twists and dead ends. Choose your controls from the options and guide the player along the route you discover.

pages.title: Hyper Neon Ball
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Hyper Neon Ball challenges you to launch a ball into a basket bin. Use the mouse and left button to set its movement path, judging the shot for each level's arrangement. You have three attempts to land a successful shot. Visit the shop to buy different ball types as you work through the stages.

pages.title: Real Cargo Truck Simulator
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Real Cargo Truck Simulator asks you to haul heavy loads through driving courses with tight turns and narrow bridges. Complete the deliveries across levels of different difficulty while handling the truck and trailer. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, use Space to brake, and press T to connect or disconnect the trailer.

pages.title: Slime Palette
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Slime Palette is a color-mixing puzzle in which moving slimes paint the squares they cross. Drag each slime along the board to reproduce the sample's colors. When more than one slime crosses the same square, their colors mix, so the routes determine the finished pattern.

pages.title: Bff Christmas Cookie Challenge
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Bff Christmas Cookie Challenge combines holiday styling with a cookie-making activity. Help the friends try Christmas outfits and makeovers, then create a separate cookie design for each girl. Use the left mouse button to play through their preparations for the celebration.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Max Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Dirt Bike Max Duel takes bikes over dirt, mountains, rocks, and other obstacles. Ride an extended adventure or compete with a friend in two-player challenges, aiming to finish within the time or ahead of the other rider. Earn money to switch bikes. Player one uses WASD, while player two uses the arrow keys.

pages.title: Farmer Challenge Party
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Farmer Challenge Party puts two players into four farming competitions: collecting chickens, planting and harvesting, vegetable battles, and fishing. Score more than the opposing farmer in each chapter. One player moves with WASD and acts with S; the other uses the arrow keys and Down arrow for actions.

pages.title: Color Line 3D
pages.creator: DesertFoxGaming
pages.description: Color Line 3D asks you to paint a road while making your way to the finish. Click and hold to lay down color, watching for obstacles along the route. Time your progress so you can keep painting without running into the hazards ahead.

pages.title: Whooo?
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Whooo? is a character-identification puzzle based on clues and visible features. Compare the hints with the characters available and try to identify the correct person quickly. Successful guesses win the challenge, with additional character cards available to unlock as you play.

pages.title: Rublox Space Farm
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Rublox Space Farm sends a farmer across a planet's platforms to gather food for a space farm. Stay clear of dangerous objects and avoid falling off the route into space. Enemy robots start shooting when they spot you. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or use touch controls to guide the farmer through the level.

pages.title: Demon Raid
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Demon Raid is a defense game about stopping a demon army before it reaches the capital. Choose strategic positions beside the road and build towers or other defenses there. Soldiers attack approaching demons, earning points from defeated enemies. Spend those points on stronger defenses or additional structures as you protect the route to the city.

pages.title: Coloring Book Glittered Unicorns
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Coloring Book Glittered Unicorns lets you paint unicorn pictures with glitter and pastel shades. Choose from twelve glitter colors and twelve pastel colors to give each drawing a look of your own. Use left mouse clicks or touch input to apply the colors.

pages.title: Shark Ships
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Shark Ships turns a circuit race into a fight for survival between armed vessels. Choose a ship, race against the others, and use power-ups such as missiles while trying to keep your own vessel from being destroyed. Work out how the different pickups help you defeat rivals and compete for the race win.

pages.title: Join Scroll Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Join Scroll Run has you build a moving team by touching new members along the route. Recruit enough people to make the group long enough to climb over the walls blocking its path. Click or tap to guide the leader and keep adding members before the next obstacle.

pages.title: Sector 781
pages.creator: Refold
pages.description: Sector 781 is a pixel-art Metroidvania with three realms to explore and fight through. Improve the character and weapons, collect shards to increase energy, and use teleports to move between areas. Laptop checkpoints save your position. On a keyboard, move with the arrow keys, jump with X, shoot with C, and open the map with M.

pages.title: SantaDays Christmas
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: SantaDays Christmas is a course-racing game about reaching the finish and collecting crowns. Compete with other racers across different maps, then spend your rewards on costumes to change the character's appearance. Play with touch or keyboard controls as you work toward winning the races.

pages.title: Space Pursuit
pages.creator: Isaske Games
pages.description: Space Pursuit puts you in a spacecraft with enemies chasing behind. Shoot the pursuers, dodge threats, and gather weapons and power-ups to help the ship survive longer. Use the arrow keys or tap the left and right sides to steer as the pursuit continues.

pages.title: Let's Fish
pages.creator: Ten Square Games
pages.description: Let's Fish is an online fishing game about landing large catches in a variety of locations. Use mouse clicks to interact with the fishing activities, and take part in daily rankings and tournaments if you want a competitive goal.

pages.title: Neighbor Alien
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Neighbor Alien is a sliding puzzle with aliens in four colors. Move them into an arrangement where aliens of the same color are not next to each other. Keep rearranging the board to separate matching colors, and solve it quickly to earn a higher score.

pages.title: Tenkyu Hole 3d rolling ball
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Tenkyu Hole 3d rolling ball asks you to guide a ball through three-dimensional stages to the goal. Tilt the stage by swiping so the ball rolls along the route. Small adjustments matter: tilting too far can send it off the platform and end the attempt.

pages.title: Drifting Mustang Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Drifting Mustang Slide offers three car pictures to reconstruct as sliding puzzles. Choose a three-by-three, four-by-four, or five-by-five grid, then use the mouse to rearrange the pieces into the complete image. Larger grids give you more fragments to organize.

pages.title: Car Impossible Stunt Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Car Impossible Stunt Driving Simulator puts you on demanding driving tracks for car stunts. Steer through the courses and work on handling the vehicle during the challenges. Use WASD to drive, Space for the handbrake, and F to activate the boost.

pages.title: Neoxplosive
pages.creator: Rodigi Games
pages.description: Neoxplosive is a physics puzzle about launching a character into targets. Drag and release to set it bouncing, using collisions to destroy what it hits. Work through twelve levels, judging the launch direction and the resulting bounces for each arrangement.

pages.title: Frenzy Snake
pages.creator: Rodigi Games
pages.description: Frenzy Snake has you steer a snake toward pellets that increase its score and length. Keep the head away from its growing body and the course's hazards as you collect more. Use the arrow keys or touch controls, with two modes and easy or expert levels available.

pages.title: Race Car Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Race Car Slide lets you reconstruct racing-car pictures as sliding puzzles. Choose from three images and three play modes, then use the mouse to move the pieces into their finished arrangement.

pages.title: Multi Tank Battle
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Multi Tank Battle pits teams of five tanks against each other. Coordinate your position with teammates, watch for enemy attacks, and destroy opposing tanks. A team wins a match at fifteen kills, and two match wins secure the battle. Move with WASD or the arrow keys; H opens help, Tab shows the scoreboard, and Escape pauses.

pages.title: US Cargo Truck Driver Racing Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: US Cargo Truck Driver Racing Game puts you behind the wheel of a heavy truck for delivery missions. Transport loads such as timber safely to complete a job and move on to the next challenge. Handling the vehicle while carrying its cargo is the main task throughout the missions.

pages.title: Family Travel Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Family Travel Jigsaw offers twelve pictures to assemble, each with three difficulty settings. Choose an easy puzzle with 25 pieces, a medium one with 49, or a hard one with 100. Use the mouse or touch input to put the pieces together and complete the selected image.

pages.title: KTM 690 Enduro R Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: KTM 690 Enduro R Slide is a sliding-picture puzzle featuring the motorcycle of the same name. Select one of three images and three play modes, then use the mouse to rearrange the fragments into the complete motorcycle picture.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Master
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Bike Stunt Master takes motorcycle riding onto stunt tracks with demanding routes to complete. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the bike through the challenges. Earn coins and rewards as you progress, with bike upgrades available to help develop your ride.

pages.title: Pipes Flood Puzzle
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pipes Flood Puzzle asks you to make a continuous water route between a starting pipe and an end pipe. Click the pipe sections to rotate them into alignment, connecting the two ends so water can flow through. Work through levels with different difficulty settings as you solve each pipe arrangement.

pages.title: Penguin Battle Christmas
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Penguin Battle Christmas follows a penguin defending his cabin from an approaching army of snowmen. Fight back to protect the home, then purchase stronger weapons and new clothing to improve the character's abilities. Play with mouse or touch input as you take on the attackers.

pages.title: Futuristic Racing 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Futuristic Racing 3D puts you in a science-fiction racing setting with three-dimensional courses. Control the vehicle with WASD or the arrow keys and steer through the races.

pages.title: Euro Railroad Crossing : Railway Train Passing 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Euro Railroad Crossing : Railway Train Passing 3D puts you in charge of gates at a railway crossing. Tap a gate to open it, controlling passage through the crossing while trains pass through the area. Keep the traffic from colliding as you manage the junction.

pages.title: Pixel Runner
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Pixel Runner is a route-building runner in which blocks must connect with the road. Click with the mouse to move the blocks and line up the path. Keep adjusting the route so the runner has a connected road to follow.

pages.title: Mad Day 2 Special
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Mad Day 2 Special sends ex-Marine Bob after aliens who have kidnapped his pet octopus. Ride through the action, shoot enemies, and jump past trouble while pursuing the rescue. Press Space to jump, press it twice for a double jump, and use X or Up arrow to launch rockets.

pages.title: Bullet Fury
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Bullet Fury is a first-person shooter set inside an enemy-controlled secret laboratory. Explore the facility and eliminate its guards. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the mouse to turn, aim, and fire. Touch controls provide a movement joystick, a fire button, and an aiming area on the right side of the screen.

pages.title: Cotton Candy Shop
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Cotton Candy Shop puts you in a dessert-making shop serving customers. Use the mouse to create cotton-candy treats and prepare sweets for the people visiting the shop.

pages.title: Hardest Game On Earth
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hardest Game On Earth sends you through mazes containing coins, keys, and obstacles. Find your way along the route, gather the items, and protect your glass from breaking. A tutorial introduces the challenge before you work through the levels.

pages.title: Sherwood Shooter
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Sherwood Shooter is an aiming challenge with an apple resting on a friend's head. Line up a shot that hits the fruit without injuring the person underneath it. Aim with the mouse or a finger, then release to fire.

pages.title: City Cargo Trailer Transport
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: City Cargo Trailer Transport has you haul cargo through mountainous terrain in a large truck and trailer. Complete the delivery on time while negotiating steep hills and rough stretches of road. Drive with WASD, use Space to brake, and press C to change the camera view.

pages.title: EG Supercars Puzzle
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Supercars Puzzle lets you rebuild pictures of sports cars from scattered image pieces. Drag each piece toward its place in the picture; it snaps into position when correctly aligned. Use the mouse or touch input to fit the fragments together and finish the car image.

pages.title: Snow Patrol
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Snow Patrol asks you to gather balls and push them into a hole. Collect enough to move into the next section, then repeat the task until the level is complete. Use the mouse to guide the collection and delivery of the balls.

pages.title: Cooking Cake Bakery Store
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Cooking Cake Bakery Store is a cake-making game built around preparing desserts for celebrations. Click the on-screen buttons to work through the cooking activities and make cakes suited to occasions such as birthdays or weddings.

pages.title: Twisty Road
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Twisty Road challenges you to guide a ball farther along a winding road. Steer to follow the route and keep the ball on the track as you try to improve the distance reached. Use A and D to control its direction.

pages.title: Helicopter Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Helicopter Puzzle Challenge offers helicopter pictures to assemble as jigsaw puzzles. Each picture has easy, medium, and hard settings, letting you choose the difficulty before putting it together. There is no time limit. Use the mouse or tap the screen to play at your own pace.

pages.title: Moto Beach
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Moto Beach is a motorbike-riding game with three modes and a high-score system. Use WASD to control the bike, Left Shift to boost, and C to change the camera. Try the different modes and work toward improving your recorded scores.

pages.title: Miami Crime Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Miami Crime Simulator 3D is a third-person action game about a police officer fighting crime in an open city. Complete missions, use weapons, and take control of vehicles including cars, tanks, and helicopters. Shops offer equipment for the jobs ahead. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and left-click to fire.

pages.title: Slenderman Must Die: Silent Forest
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Slenderman Must Die: Silent Forest sends you into woods, abandoned buildings, and a campsite to hunt Slenderman and collect eight pages. Explore in day or night mode while facing the danger with firearms. Move with WASD, look with the mouse, left-click to fire, and right-click to aim.

pages.title: Node
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Node is a line-drawing puzzle about completing all the connections in a diagram. Click and drag between nodes to draw each line, planning a route that avoids going over the same node twice. Study how the points connect before tracing your way through the pattern.

pages.title: Angry Zombies
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Angry Zombies is a single-player slingshot game about bringing down zombie defenses. Aim your shots at the defensive structures and destroy them to complete each level. Work out where a slingshot attack will do the most useful damage in the current arrangement.

pages.title: Color Pipes
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Color Pipes asks you to join dots of matching colors with pipes while covering the board. Plan each connection so it leaves room for the others: crossing or overlapping pipes breaks them. You can reverse moves and choose different levels as you work out a complete set of routes.

pages.title: Inca Challenge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Inca Challenge is a memory game with cards bearing Inca symbols. Turn cards over in pairs and remember the pictures you uncover. Matching symbols remove a pair from the board; different symbols turn face down again, giving you another chance to remember their positions.

pages.title: Black Hole.io
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Black Hole.io lets you control a growing black hole that consumes objects around the world. Swallow people, cars, and buildings to increase its size, while staying away from enemy holes larger than your own. Keep gathering objects as you look for room to grow.

pages.title: New York Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: New York Jigsaw Puzzle lets you assemble pictures of city landmarks, including the Empire State Building, Brooklyn Bridge, and Central Park. Adjust the number of pieces in each row or column to set up the puzzle. Hints, a zoom function, and different backgrounds help you organize the pieces as you rebuild each view.

pages.title: Clowns VS Aliens
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description: Clowns VS Aliens has clowns defend Earth with balloons. Drag a balloon into position and let go so it rises toward the invaders, striking them on its way up. Destroying aliens earns points that unlock assistance and help you win medals as you defend the planet.

pages.title: Sweets Time!
pages.creator: HongByte
pages.description: Sweets Time! is a candy-matching game about feeding a teddy bear. Match sweets to give the bear more treats, aiming to combine as many candies as possible.

pages.title: Birthday Suprise Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Birthday Suprise Party follows Erika as she gets ready for her birthday celebration. Decorate the room with balloons, presents, and other party ornaments, then choose a dress and accessories for her. Put together both the party setting and the birthday outfit.

pages.title: Ball In The Hole
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ball In The Hole is a physics puzzle about shooting a ball into a target container. Drag to set the shot's direction and strength, then release to launch the ball. Judge the angle around the blocks in each arrangement and try to reach the target with fewer shots.

pages.title: Emoji - My Moji Maker
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Emoji - My Moji Maker lets you design a personal cartoon avatar and turn it into expressive emoji-style stickers. Customize the caricature, then explore the sticker collection featuring your character. Build a set of expressions around the avatar you create.

pages.title: Basket Slam Dunk
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Basket Slam Dunk mixes basketball scoring with unusual physics and one-touch controls. Play for a higher personal score and use your earnings to buy different balls. Twelve ball designs are available to unlock, giving you more options as you continue playing.

pages.title: Zebra Caring
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Zebra Caring has two stages of looking after a zebra. Start by cleaning away the dirt from her coat, then move on to styling a new look. Complete the care tasks before choosing how to dress up the freshly cleaned animal.

pages.title: Trendy Outfits for Princess
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Trendy Outfits for Princess explores a princess's wardrobe for three interests: street racing, hip-hop dancing, and a private fashion party. Try the clothing associated with each activity and put together different looks. Dress the princess for each setting using the outfits in her collection.

pages.title: Run Panda Run
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Run Panda Run follows a panda collecting coins on the way home. Jump over obstacles and gather as many coins as you can before reaching the end. Click the mouse to jump, or double-click to make a double jump when the route calls for extra height.

pages.title: Cake Bar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Cake Bar puts you in charge of preparing cakes for waiting customers. Check their orders, choose the ingredients that match a recipe, and press Create to make the cake. Finished cakes travel along a conveyor to customers who ordered them. The recipe selection expands across levels, adding more combinations to prepare.

pages.title: Banana Split Pie: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Banana Split Pie: Sara's Cooking Class brings you into Sara's kitchen to prepare a sweet dessert. Follow the cooking activity as she makes a banana split pie, using the mouse or keyboard to play through the preparation.

pages.title: Fancy Girls Quiz
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fancy Girls Quiz asks about your favorite things to find out which kind of fancy girl suits your mood. Choose answers based on your preferences and see the personality-style result the quiz gives you.

pages.title: Big Monsters Racing
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Big Monsters Racing puts monster trucks on a route filled with obstacles. Drive over the hazards and keep heading toward the finish line, working to get the truck through the course.

pages.title: Girls Shopping Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Shopping Fun lets you help six girls choose outfits for a shopping trip. Pick a favorite character and dress her in clothes you like, then explore the other girls' looks. Combine the available clothing into outfits for their outing.
